name: BESCOM LT-2(a) Bengaluru Urban domestic FY2025-26
source: KERC Tariff Order FY2025-26, Schedule LT-2(a) Domestic: Telescopic slabs 0-100 kWh @ 4.75 Rs/kWh, >100 kWh @ 7.00 Rs/kWh. Modelled at upper tier 7.00 Rs/kWh; fixed charge Rs 110/kW/month; export net-metering rate 3.10 Rs/kWh (KERC Generic Solar PPA rate).

notes: Modelled on KERC FY2025-26 LT-2(a) tariff schedule. Marginal rate 7.00 INR/kWh applied for solar displacement calculations.
Net-metering buyback credited at KERC benchmark solar export tariff.
